projects.name: Healthcare Pricing & Medicare Calculation Platform
projects.overview: A cloud-native pricing engine running on AWS EKS that performs distributed Medicare and commercial pricing calculations for business-critical healthcare workflows, built to HIPAA and SOC 2 standards. Delivered using Spec Kit driven (spec-driven) development with Claude as the AI coding agent inside Windsurf, so every feature traces back to an executable, reviewed specification.
useCases: Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) / MS-DRG pricing calculations.
Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS) / APC pricing calculations.
Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) and Home Health / Hospice pricing.
Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule (CLFS) and DMEPOS pricing.
Commercial contract and custom fee-schedule pricing alongside Medicare rates.
Bulk claim repricing and high-volume batch reprocessing runs.
Effective-dated rate versioning so historical claims price against the correct period.
Pricing explainability and audit trails showing how each rate was derived.
Rate-table ingestion and validation from CMS reference data releases.
Exposed pricing APIs consumed by downstream claims and billing systems.
practices: Spec Kit driven development: every change begins as a written specification that is reviewed before any code is generated.
Used the Spec Kit workflow end to end — constitution, specify, plan, tasks and implement phases.
Claude used as the AI coding agent to turn approved specs into implementation plans, task breakdowns and code.
Windsurf used as the AI-assisted IDE for day-to-day development, refactoring and code review.
Specifications kept as the source of truth and versioned in the repository alongside the code.
Architect-led review of every AI-generated plan and task list before implementation.
Test coverage and acceptance criteria derived directly from the specification.
Documented prompting and spec-authoring conventions so the workflow is repeatable across the team.
responsibilities: Own the platform architecture and technical delivery end to end.
Introduced and championed Spec Kit driven development with Claude and Windsurf across the team.
Redesigned distributed calculation flows and introduced Redis caching for hot pricing data.
Defined Terraform modules and CI/CD pipeline patterns reused across teams.
Led architecture governance and cross-team design reviews for compliance-sensitive services.
Set standards for security, resilience and operability across environments.
projects.impact: Cut pricing-calculation response time from 45 seconds to under 2 seconds and improved environment provisioning speed by 60%. Spec-driven development with Claude and Windsurf shortened the path from requirement to reviewed implementation and kept specs, tests and code in sync.
